props.gloss_en: (the mishnah, cited) [on the seventeenth of Tammuz] the city was breached
'in the fourth month, on the ninth of the month, the famine was severe in the city' (Jer 52:6), and after it: 'and the city was breached' (Jer 52:7)
Rava: here [the verse] -- at the first
Rava: here [the mishnah] -- at the second
the baraita: at the first, the city was breached on the ninth of Tammuz
the baraita: at the second, on its seventeenth

supports.gloss_en: דתניא: בראשונה הובקעה העיר בתשעה בתמוז, בשניה בשבעה עשר בו -- the second clause, for the mishnah's okimta (plain דתניא has no SupportKind; svara under protest)
